You are implementing Task 4: the Temporal driver test.

## Task Description
Read your task brief first — it is your requirements, with the exact values to use verbatim:
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/task-4-brief.md

/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/global-constraints.md

## Context
SMA-864: the agent loop must not run tool calls from a model turn that ended with `FinishReason::Length` or `ContentFilter`. Task 2 (commit e3434f48) added a guard arm to the pure `transition` in `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/loop_state.rs`: CallingModel + ModelResponse with Length/ContentFilter and ≥1 ToolCall → `LoopState::Failed(AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun{..})` with Terminate. The Temporal driver (`crates/paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal/src/driver.rs`) calls the same `transition`, so this task adds only a test there, with no production change. The Temporal error mapping (`runtime-temporal/src/error.rs`, `ErrorKindPayload::from_agent_error`) has a wildcard, so the new variant maps to `ErrorKindPayload::Other { .. }` — that is why the test asserts `Other`.

Rulings: Step 2's mutation check temporarily edits the core guard arm in loop_state.rs. Make that edit, run, and then restore the file exactly (verify with `git diff --stat crates/paigasus-helikon-core` showing nothing before you commit). Do NOT use git stash/checkout/restore to revert it; revert by editing back. Record the FAIL output from the mutated run in your report. Commit only driver.rs.

## Before You Begin
If anything in the brief is unclear, ask now.

## Your Job
Write the test, run it, do the mutation check, restore, `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, commit (stage by explicit path), self-review, report.

Work from: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864 (absolute paths; `cd ... || exit 1`).

Safety: never run git checkout, switch, reset, rebase, stash, restore, or anything that moves HEAD or a branch. Do not push. Do not dispatch subagents. Run every cargo command in the foreground and wait for it to end; do not end your turn until every command has finished. If the commit fails with a 1Password error, stop and report BLOCKED; never bypass signing.

Run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal --lib` once before committing.

## Report Format
Write the full report to:
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/task-4-report.md
Include: what you implemented, tests and results, evidence (PASS run; mutated FAIL run output; restored PASS run), files changed, self-review findings, concerns.

Then reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status (DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT), commits (short SHA + subject), one-line test summary, concerns, report file path.

<system-reminder>
Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.
</system-reminder>
